cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may organize the picnic as my second-in-command. I've brought the packing list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we share the work equally?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Equal packing is approved. You execute half the list; I direct the whole operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then can I at least choose dessert?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may choose two options for my approval. Pack both; I may need to compare them on location.

reason: Ground the deputy negotiation in packing and dessert choice, with B autonomy request becoming a concrete service task still subject to A final direction.
